_comment: A charger with TLS half-configured, which is the state the Web server
section exists to make visible. www_certificate_id still holds the id of
a certificate that has since been deleted, so the Select falls back to
None, web_server_setup() finds no key and serves plain HTTP, and the
charger reports HTTPS as enabled while none is running.
It also carries www_http_enabled: false, which the firmware ignores while
the HTTP toggle should read on and locked rather than off.
Pick 'openevse.local' in the certificate Select to walk out of it: the
warning clears, the HTTP toggle unlocks, and the restart prompt appears.
